CREATE TABLE loop_item_executions (
    id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
    loop_item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning loop item id' DEFAULT '', 
    cloud_project_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning cloud project id' DEFAULT '', 
    agent_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Executing robot id' DEFAULT '', 
    execution_environment VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Execution environment: local/cloud' DEFAULT '', 
    execution_device_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Bound execution device id; empty when unbound' DEFAULT '', 
    assigner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'User id that assigned the run' DEFAULT '0', 
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Run status (pending_approval/queued/claimed/running/completed/failed/cancelled)' DEFAULT 'queued', 
    priority_weight INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Queue priority weight' DEFAULT '0', 
    queued_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Queue entry time; 1970-01-01 00:00:00 means unset' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
    started_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Run start time; 1970-01-01 00:00:00 means unset' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
    completed_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Terminal time; 1970-01-01 00:00:00 means unset' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
    lease_expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Claim lease expiry; 1970-01-01 00:00:00 means unset' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
    heartbeat_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last heartbeat; 1970-01-01 00:00:00 means unset' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
    retry_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Current retry attempt' DEFAULT '0', 
    max_retries INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Maximum retry attempts' DEFAULT '1', 
    error_message TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last error message; empty when none' DEFAULT (''), 
    execution_note VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Human-readable run note' DEFAULT '', 
    approval_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Manual approval status (pending/approved/rejected); empty when none' DEFAULT '', 
    approved_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Approving user id; 0 means none' DEFAULT '0', 
    approved_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Approval time; 1970-01-01 00:00:00 means unset' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
    rejected_reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Rejection reason; empty when none' DEFAULT '', 
    runtime_device_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Executor device id; empty when unset' DEFAULT '', 
    runtime_task_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Executor runtime task id; empty when unset' DEFAULT '', 
    execution_payload TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Prebuilt runtime.tasks.create payload' DEFAULT (''), 
    version INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Optimistic lock version' DEFAULT '1', 
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time' DEFAULT now(), 
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last update time' DEFAULT now(), 
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_device_status_order ON loop_item_executions (execution_device_id, status, priority_weight, queued_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_assigner_status ON loop_item_executions (assigner_user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_agent_status ON loop_item_executions (agent_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_item_status ON loop_item_executions (loop_item_id, status)
